name: Froonze
summary: Modular Shopify app for customer retention: loyalty points, VIP tiers, referrals, store credit, a wishlist with restock and price-drop alerts, reviews and an enhanced customer account page, each switched on and billed separately.
best_for: Shopify stores that want loyalty points, VIP tiers, referrals and a wishlist with restock and price-drop alerts from one vendor, paying only for the modules they use, including small stores under 100 orders a month that can run Loyalty and Wishlist for free
skip_if: you already run separate best-of-breed apps for reviews and loyalty that you are happy with, you need one fixed price regardless of order volume, or your store still uses legacy customer accounts and you want store-credit rewards
honest_knock: Modular pricing is cheap per plugin but adds up: Loyalty, Wishlist, Reviews and Accounts at the 500-order level is $40 a month, so compare the sum, not the first line. Tiers move with your order count over the past 30 days, and the listing does not say what happens on the day you cross a limit. The 14-day trial is spent once for the whole app, so a plugin you switch on later gets no fresh trial. Store-credit rewards need New Customer Accounts.

pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-25 on the Shopify App Store listing apps.shopify.com/customer-accounts and on froonze.com/pricing, where we stepped through every plan in the price simulator) Froonze is one app with separate plugins, and each plugin is priced on its own, billed in USD through Shopify every 30 days. Loyalty: Free for shops with fewer than 100 orders a month, Advanced $10 a month up to 500 monthly orders (VIP tiers, referrals, points expiration, Shopify POS, integrations), Premium $30 up to 1,000 orders, Unlimited $60 with no order cap, mobile wallet cards for POS, the checkout extension for Shopify Plus stores and the API. Wishlist: Free, then $10, $20 and $40 by order volume. Reviews: $5, $10, $15 or $50. Accounts: $5, $10, $20 or $30. Forms: $6, $12 or $30 by features. A store running Loyalty and Wishlist on Advanced pays $20 a month. The 14-day free trial covers the whole app once, on first install, not each plugin. The pricing FAQ says plan changes and cancellations are prorated.

compare_with.name: Loyalino
compare_with.why: Loyalino is in our dossiers and lives on Marketing and Sales Software: it was free up to 200 loyalty orders a month and $29 a month up to 500 when we read it on 22 September 2026, metered on loyalty orders only. Froonze's free Loyalty plan stops at 100 orders and Advanced is $10 up to 500 (read 25 October 2026), counted on all orders, and the same app adds a wishlist, reviews and an account page as separate plugins. Loyalino fits a store that wants a loyalty programme only; Froonze fits one that wants several retention tools from one vendor.

exit_test.what: The app was installed on our Shopify development store, which we set up, and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session tested Froonze Loyalty & Wishlist on the Free plans of a Shopify development store: the install, the Loyalty onboarding with a points rule, saving the app embed in the theme, the plan screens up to the Shopify approval screen for Loyalty Advanced (not approved, a payment method was asked) and the uninstall dialog. Nothing was paid, approved or uninstalled. Install: the App Store listing (English) is called Froonze VIP Loyalty & Wishlist and says Free plan available. Free trial available.; in the admin the app is called Froonze Loyalty & Wishlist. The Install click at about 11:00 opened the dialog Install app with access to customer data, staff and contributor data and store data (view and edit), which was accepted. The welcome screen said Your shop has less than 100 monthly orders which makes it eligible for free Wishlist and Loyalty plugins.; Wishlist and Loyalty were switched on with Activate and no Shopify payment screen appeared. A chat window of the vendor opened at once and was closed. Core action: Loyalty onboarding, Next, the Points program was chosen (the alternative is a Store credit program), the cashback default of 4 percent was kept (the text says For each $100 spent, your customers will earn 400 points, which they can later redeem for a $4 discount), Create program rules, Activate now, and for the email notifications we chose I'll activate later, so no emails are active. Theme: Install for the app embed opened the theme editor, where the app embed Loyalty & Referrals was already on (toast Loyalty & Referrals activated) and the theme was saved (toast Changes saved.). That is a real change to the live theme of our development store and it is still on; the vendor needs it for the installation. Result in the app: Successfully installed. You can continue with the setup; the check list said Account page widget: No and Audit: No, finish onboarding. Program, Earning rules shows the rule Place an order, 4 points per 1USD spent, switched on (Active). In the theme editor preview we saw no widget or launcher on the home page. No order was placed, so no points could show; the Performance summary shows Activity 0, Points earned 0 and Emails sent 0. Timing, approximate tester observations: about 3 minutes from 11:00 to 11:03 and about 20 clicks, counting the onboarding and saving the theme. Plans: Manage plans starts with the note Plugin prices are flat monthly fees. You get 14-day free trial for your first subscription. You can test all of our app features for free in development stores. Wishlist: Free $0 (100 orders, All features), Advanced $10 (500 orders), Premium $20 (1000 orders) and Unlimited $40 (Unlimited orders, API). Loyalty program: Free $0 (100 orders, Points program, Store credit), Advanced $10 (500 orders, VIP program, Referral program, Shopify POS, Points expiration, integrations with Judge.me, PushOwl and Shopify Flow), Premium $30 (1000 orders, a customer tags blacklist and whitelist) and Unlimited $60 (Unlimited orders, Digital cards, API). The customer account widget shows $5 - 30/mo and the custom forms $6 - 30/mo with the label Legacy Accounts only. Under the plans there is a field Please consider adding a monthly tip (0) and Total: $10 / Month. Checkout: Loyalty Advanced was chosen and Update pressed; the app then said that after clicking Yes we would be prompted to accept a new Shopify recurring charge and that the old recurring charge would be cancelled automatically. The Shopify Approve subscription screen showed the plan Wishlist(Free) + Loyalty(Advanced), $10,00 USD every 30 days, You have a 14-day free trial ending on 1 Dec., Subtotal $10,00 plus any applicable taxes and Total $10,00 due 1 Dec. It did not say that the charge is a test charge that will not be billed; it showed Add payment method, and the Approve button was greyed out. Nothing was approved; Cancel gave the toast The shop cannot accept the provided charge. Cancelling: the plans stayed Free for both, so there was no paid plan to cancel. The routes seen are going back to the Free plan (not tried) and the Uninstall item in the app menu (the three dots, with Manage app, Get support, Pin to your navigation and Uninstall). The Uninstall dialog says that after uninstalling any data managed by the app, such as discounts, will be deleted, and that a request is sent to the developer within 48 hours to delete all personal customer information; it was cancelled and nothing was removed. The pricing FAQ of the vendor (read on 25 October, not read again) says cancelling is possible at any time and is prorated. Not tested: a real order and earning points on the storefront, the widget in the theme preview (not seen), the wishlist heart on product pages (only switched on, not shown), store credit and legacy accounts, the behaviour above 100 orders, paying for a plan, the trial, a plan downgrade and the email templates. Clean up: the app stays installed, both plans stay Free, the Place an order rule is active, the email notifications are off and the app embed is on and saved in the theme. All tabs were closed. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The app embed has to be saved in the live theme, the Advanced plan could not be approved without a payment method although development stores are said to test all features free, and no widget showed in the theme preview.

exit_test.what: The app was installed on our Shopify development store, which we set up, and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session tested Froonze Loyalty & Wishlist on the Free plans of a Shopify development store: the install, the Loyalty onboarding with a points rule, saving the app embed in the theme, the plan screens up to the Shopify approval screen for Loyalty Advanced (not approved, a payment method was asked) and the uninstall dialog. Nothing was paid, approved or uninstalled. Install: the App Store listing (English) is called Froonze VIP Loyalty & Wishlist and says Free plan available. Free trial available.; in the admin the app is called Froonze Loyalty & Wishlist. The Install click at about 11:00 opened the dialog Install app with access to customer data, staff and contributor data and store data (view and edit), which was accepted. The welcome screen said Your shop has less than 100 monthly orders which makes it eligible for free Wishlist and Loyalty plugins.; Wishlist and Loyalty were switched on with Activate and no Shopify payment screen appeared. A chat window of the vendor opened at once and was closed. Core action: Loyalty onboarding, Next, the Points program was chosen (the alternative is a Store credit program), the cashback default of 4 percent was kept (the text says For each $100 spent, your customers will earn 400 points, which they can later redeem for a $4 discount), Create program rules, Activate now, and for the email notifications we chose I'll activate later, so no emails are active. Theme: Install for the app embed opened the theme editor, where the app embed Loyalty & Referrals was already on (toast Loyalty & Referrals activated) and the theme was saved (toast Changes saved.). That is a real change to the live theme of our development store and it is still on; the vendor needs it for the installation. Result in the app: Successfully installed. You can continue with the setup; the check list said Account page widget: No and Audit: No, finish onboarding. Program, Earning rules shows the rule Place an order, 4 points per 1USD spent, switched on (Active). In the theme editor preview we saw no widget or launcher on the home page. No order was placed, so no points could show; the Performance summary shows Activity 0, Points earned 0 and Emails sent 0. Timing, approximate tester observations: about 3 minutes from 11:00 to 11:03 and about 20 clicks, counting the onboarding and saving the theme. Plans: Manage plans starts with the note Plugin prices are flat monthly fees. You get 14-day free trial for your first subscription. You can test all of our app features for free in development stores. Wishlist: Free $0 (100 orders, All features), Advanced $10 (500 orders), Premium $20 (1000 orders) and Unlimited $40 (Unlimited orders, API). Loyalty program: Free $0 (100 orders, Points program, Store credit), Advanced $10 (500 orders, VIP program, Referral program, Shopify POS, Points expiration, integrations with Judge.me, PushOwl and Shopify Flow), Premium $30 (1000 orders, a customer tags blacklist and whitelist) and Unlimited $60 (Unlimited orders, Digital cards, API). The customer account widget shows $5 - 30/mo and the custom forms $6 - 30/mo with the label Legacy Accounts only. Under the plans there is a field Please consider adding a monthly tip (0) and Total: $10 / Month. Checkout: Loyalty Advanced was chosen and Update pressed; the app then said that after clicking Yes we would be prompted to accept a new Shopify recurring charge and that the old recurring charge would be cancelled automatically. The Shopify Approve subscription screen showed the plan Wishlist(Free) + Loyalty(Advanced), $10,00 USD every 30 days, You have a 14-day free trial ending on 1 Dec., Subtotal $10,00 plus any applicable taxes and Total $10,00 due 1 Dec. It did not say that the charge is a test charge that will not be billed; it showed Add payment method, and the Approve button was greyed out. Nothing was approved; Cancel gave the toast The shop cannot accept the provided charge. Cancelling: the plans stayed Free for both, so there was no paid plan to cancel. The routes seen are going back to the Free plan (not tried) and the Uninstall item in the app menu (the three dots, with Manage app, Get support, Pin to your navigation and Uninstall). The Uninstall dialog says that after uninstalling any data managed by the app, such as discounts, will be deleted, and that a request is sent to the developer within 48 hours to delete all personal customer information; it was cancelled and nothing was removed. The pricing FAQ of the vendor (read on 25 October, not read again) says cancelling is possible at any time and is prorated. Not tested: a real order and earning points on the storefront, the widget in the theme preview (not seen), the wishlist heart on product pages (only switched on, not shown), store credit and legacy accounts, the behaviour above 100 orders, paying for a plan, the trial, a plan downgrade and the email templates. Clean up: the app stays installed, both plans stay Free, the Place an order rule is active, the email notifications are off and the app embed is on and saved in the theme. All tabs were closed. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The app embed has to be saved in the live theme, the Advanced plan could not be approved without a payment method although development stores are said to test all features free, and no widget showed in the theme preview.
